description: This Java class defines Swagger API documentation models for the PaymentType API in the Apache Fineract project, including responses for GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE operations related to payment types.

classes.name: PaymentTypeApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining Swagger schema models for payment type API responses and requests.

classes.name: PaymentTypeApiResourceSwagger.GetPaymentTypesResponse
classes.description: Schema model for the response returned when retrieving payment types.

classes.name: PaymentTypeApiResourceSwagger.PostPaymentTypesResponse
classes.description: Schema model for the response when creating a new payment type.

classes.name: PaymentTypeApiResourceSwagger.PutPaymentTypesPaymentTypeIdRequest
classes.description: Schema model for the request payload to update a payment type.

classes.name: PaymentTypeApiResourceSwagger.PutPaymentTypesPaymentTypeIdResponse
classes.description: Schema model for the response after updating a payment type.

classes.name: PaymentTypeApiResourceSwagger.DeletePaymentTypesPaymentTypeIdResponse
classes.description: Schema model for the response after deleting a payment type.
